sql.value: select a.id, a.name, a.description, a.model_id, a.system_prompt, a.tool_ids, a.max_iterations, a.temperature, a.top_p, a.max_tokens, a.enable_status, a.sort, a.create_by, a.create_time, a.update_by, a.update_time, m.model_name as model_name from ai_agent a left join ai_model m on m.id = a.model_id where a.is_deleted=0 #[and a.name like :name] #[and a.enable_status = :enableStatus] order by a.sort desc, a.id desc

select l.id, l.agent_id, l.agent_name, l.conversation_id, l.user_id, l.user_input, l.final_response, l.iteration_count, l.tool_calls, l.prompt_tokens, l.completion_tokens, l.total_tokens, l.cost, l.status, l.error_msg, l.execution_time_ms, l.created_time from ai_agent_log l where 1=1 #[and l.agent_id = :agentId] #[and l.status = :status] order by l.created_time desc
